title: Top 5 Computer Hardware Picks (November 2026)
description: November 2026 computer hardware picks: LG 27UL500-W 4K monitor about 63% off, Samsung and WD_BLACK NVMe SSDs, Samsung T7 Shield portable SSD, and a 4K HDMI cable pack. #ad
intro: PC storage and display upgrades for November 2026, with compatibility notes on each card. Featured store is amazon.com. Expect NVMe SSDs, a portable drive, a 4K monitor, and a short HDMI cable pack.
disclosure: Every product link opens the retailer's own store page in an external link. This page is not a shop. Some links are affiliate or partner links. If you buy through them, I may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases. Prices change; check the retailer for live pricing.

products.name: LG 27UL500-W 27-inch 4K UHD Monitor (Now **$259.99**, was ~~$699.99~~
products.note: Now $259.99, was $699.99. 27-inch IPS panel, 3840x2160 (4K UHD). AMD FreeSync support. Connectivity typically includes HDMI and DisplayPort (check the listing for your GPU outputs). VESA mount compatible on many units. Strong early-season cut vs the historical list price.

products.name: Samsung 990 EVO Plus 1TB NVMe SSD
products.note: Now $235.35, was $289.99. Internal M.2 2280 NVMe SSD. Interface: PCIe Gen 4 x4 / Gen 5 x2 hybrid. Sequential read up to about 7,150 MB/s. Form factor M.2 2280, NVMe 2.0. Fits motherboards and laptops with a free M.2 NVMe slot (check length and heatsink clearance).

products.name: WD_BLACK SN850X 1TB NVMe SSD
products.note: Gaming-focused internal SSD. Interface: PCIe Gen4 x4, NVMe. Form factor M.2 2280. Sequential read up to about 7,300 MB/s. Confirm your board supports Gen4 M.2 and that the drive fits under any existing heatsink.

products.name: Samsung T7 Shield 1TB Portable SSD
products.note: Rugged portable SSD. Interface: USB 3.2 Gen 2 (10 Gbps) with USB-C. Sequential speeds up to about 1,050 MB/s. IP65-rated shell for dust and water resistance. Works with Windows, macOS, and Android devices that support USB storage.

products.name: PHILIPS 4K HDMI Cable 2-Pack (4 ft)
products.note: Two short HDMI cables rated for 4K at up to 120 Hz and about 10.2 Gbps data. Useful when adding a 4K monitor or console to a desk build. Confirm your GPU and display both support the refresh rate you want.
